rust_summary: the render hook point `native_world_pre_post(world)`: the world is drawn, before finishing passes (`WorldPrePost`).
doc_summary:
the render hook point `native_world_pre_post(world)`, after world transparency and before shader-pack post passes
or built-in world post/TAA, with writable world depth, camera history and frame lighting (`WorldPrePost`). Bundles need `"hooks": @API:world_pre_post@`.
